title: Attune: A Self-Annotation Tool for Understanding Robot Operator Attention Profiles
description:
arXiv:2608.12650v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Deploying robot fleets in complex, real-world environments requires human operators to supervise multiple robots simultaneously. Managing operator attention is a fundamental challenge of designing multi-robot supervision interfaces, encompassing both feed layout and feed content (i.e., robot behavior design).
